description: Turn up to 3 reference images (a character, a product, a place) and a prompt into a 5-second video that keeps them consistent. 480p, 768p or 1080p. Compared with other video tools: mid-priced, and one of the most used right now. Price: from $0.298 per video, charged only on success. Price depends on resolution: 480p $0.298, 768p $0.400, 1080p $0.535 (default 768p). One call = one short video.

images.description: 1 to 3 public image links (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 4 megapixels each)

prompt.description: What happens in the video, referring to the images (e.g. 'the woman in image 1 holds the bottle from image 2')
